questions.question: Which fish species does AZAFCO International supply?
questions.answer: Our 12 main species are tilapia, grey mullet, thinlip mullet, sea bass, sea bream, meagre, common carp, mirror carp, grass carp, silver carp, catfish and bayad catfish. These are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request.

questions.question: Which markets do you ship to?
questions.answer: We ship by air and road to {countries}+ markets: the UAE (since 2008), Kuwait (2009), Bahrain (2012), Lebanon (2015), Qatar (2024), Iraq (2025) and Syria (2026). Europe is next in our plan, together with Russia and the USA. Exports to Spain are paused.

questions.question: Which certificates do you hold?
questions.answer: We hold three ISO certificates: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

questions.question: Do you farm the fish yourselves?
questions.answer: We farm and source fish, then inspect, wash, ice, grade and pack it, and export it. We run our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores, so every stage is handled by AZAFCO, from the pond to the pallet.

questions.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
questions.answer: Quantities are agreed per order and depend on the species, the destination and the shipping mode. Tell us the quantity you need and our export team will review it.

questions.question: Can you supply specific sizes?
questions.answer: Our fish are graded by weight. We agree the weight grade and the packing with you before each shipment.

questions.question: How is the fish shipped?
questions.answer: Whole and fresh chilled, packed on ice. Our own refrigerated trucks take each shipment to air or road freight.

questions.question: How are prices set?
questions.answer: Prices are confirmed per order. They depend on the species, weight grade, quantity, packing and destination. Payment terms are agreed with our export team.

questions.question: What is your packing capacity?
questions.answer: Our packing capacity is up to 2,500 t/month.

questions.question: When was AZAFCO International founded?
questions.answer: AZAFCO International was founded in 2008. Our processing plant is in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt.

questions.question: Who do you supply?
questions.answer: We supply businesses: importers, distributors and foodservice buyers, including hotel and restaurant suppliers.

questions.question: What are your office hours, and how do I reach you?
questions.answer: Our office hours are Saturday to Thursday, 8:00–17:00 (Cairo time). For fast deals, WhatsApp reaches management directly on +20 100 773 6419. For details and documents, email our export team at business@azafco.com.eg.

questions.question: How can I check that a message really comes from AZAFCO International?
questions.answer: Our official channels are WhatsApp +20 100 773 6419 (management) and email from the azafco.com.eg domain (export team: business@azafco.com.eg). If you receive bank details or payment instructions from any other number or address, confirm them with us on one of these channels before paying.

questions.question: How do I start a partnership?
questions.answer: Send your requirements: the species, quantity and destination. Our export team will review supply and commercial terms with you.
